explanation: The lower paraboloid has outward vector area element ⟨2x,2y,-1⟩ dA, giving F·dS=(2xy-x) dA. The upper disk has outward normal ⟨0,0,1⟩ and contributes x dA. Adding gives 2xy, option a. All choices integrate to zero over the symmetric disk, but a directly represents the combined surface contributions.
